name: Wholesale Apparel LLC
old_description: Screen Printing is a strong, cost-effective way for your company to promote its goods, services and image! Whether you order printed T-shirts for a corporate event or to promote yourself, customized apparel is going to make your organization look professional.
about:
Wholesale Apparel LLC operates from Dover, New Jersey. The company has been active in the custom apparel industry for over a decade, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been shared. The business began as a custom apparel supplier serving both local and global clients.

The company provides screen printing, embroidery, and graphic design services for wholesale apparel. Its capabilities include bulk screen printing on T-shirts, embroidered hats and polo shirts, and custom design creation. The facility uses what it describes as state-of-the-art printing technology, though no details on equipment models, facility size, or production volumes are provided.

Wholesale Apparel serves small businesses, larger enterprises, and organizations needing promotional apparel for corporate events, branding, and marketing. Customers include buyers who previously used services like Custom Ink, as noted in a testimonial. The company ships to both domestic and international clients, though specific industries are not enumerated.

The company emphasizes a balance of affordability and quality, highlighting quick turnaround times, competitive pricing, and personalized designs as its core differentiators. It positions itself as a one-stop shop for wholesale custom printing and design needs.
type_evidence: Our team has immense amount of knowledge from years of experience as a custom apparel supplier
